title: History tab and debug screen
body: SidebarTab.History hosts TickHistoryView bound to TickHistoryViewModel; IsPaused is fed via AttachPanelViewModel.ApplyStatus. Selecting a tick while paused shows registers, each chip's decoded state, and a reconstructed scrolling hex dump.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Refresh lists ticks newest-first; inspect while paused opens the debug screen
Inspect while running does not open the debug screen
